rp2040_capture.source: Raspberry Pi RP2040 datasheet Figure 3 (printed p11), sections 1.4.2, 2.9, 2.10; https://datasheets.raspberrypi.com/rp2040/rp2040-datasheet.pdf
rp2040_capture.status: Corrected candidate capture only, NOT layout or complete electrical approval. Application GPIO allocation is provisional, not mandated by freeze.
rp2040_capture.ground_pad_note: Datasheet Table 621 explicitly assigns central GND pad 57; local QFN footprint also uses 57. TESTEN pad 19 also grounded.
rp2040_capture.power_scheme: Section 2.9.7.1 single 3.3V; VREG_VOUT connected externally to both DVDD pads on +1V1_MCU, never +3V3_MCU.

usb_programming.status: Candidate service/programming port, not USB compliance or physical boot approval
usb_programming.source: Raspberry Pi Hardware design with RP2040 section 2.2 QSPI_SS boot strap and 1k; RP2040 datasheet section 1.4.2 USB 27R, section 2.8 bootrom
usb_programming.power_policy: Self-powered ONLY from protected external 9-18V. USB_VBUS connects only connector1 and USBLC6 pin5; never +5V_PCBA, +3V3 or GPIO. No power ORing. External source protection contract unchanged. SWD voltage reference is not power input.
usb_programming.operating_policy: Service port: attach cable to a powered host before applying external board power; hold BOOTSEL, press/release RESET, release BOOTSEL. Remove external power before host shutdown/disconnection. No VBUS detector: autonomous hotplug/suspend/self-powered USB compliance NOT claimed; ROM cannot be assumed to gate pullup with VBUS. No external supply means no boot/enumeration.

connector.source: Molex SD-105017-001; ID unconnected, shell6 directly ground; micro-B has no CC resistors

esd.source: ST USBLC6-2 datasheet Figure 2 top view, paired I/O1 1/6 I/O2 3/4; VBUS5 GND2

switch.source: C&K PTS636 March2025 drawing, two terminals NO; G lead 2.5mm variant

usb_programming.procurement: Exact electrical selections, live JLC stock/price unverified; C136000/C7519 search leads only, switch JLC not located. Molex and ST drawing dimensional approval remains open.

boot_core.status: Candidate capture, not physically validated; sourcing unconfirmed

ldo.source: TI SBVS320D Figure 4-2 Table 4-1 and sections 7.3.3, 8.1.1
ldo.power_policy: Always enabled from regulated +5V_PCBA; SWD pin 1 voltage-reference output only, not external power input. No USB VBUS connection. No reverse-power protection.
ldo.limits: 1.45-5.5V input, 500mA electrical limit; thermal budget must be validated, not a 500mA board rating.

crystal.source: Abracon drawing 456603 rev B; Raspberry Pi Hardware design with RP2040 section 2.3 Figure 8
crystal.load_note: 15pF/2 + assumed 3pF parasitic = 10.5pF vs 10pF specified; layout and temperature startup/drive verification required

flash.sourcing: LCSC live product page C131025 fetched: exact W25Q16JVSSIQ, SOIC-8-208mil match. JLC assembly availability NOT verified. Distributor search indicates EOL: lifecycle review required.

buck_proposal.status: PROPOSED replacement, not operator-approved amendment of frozen row 14
buck_proposal.frozen_part: TPS62162 (17 V maximum recommended input incompatible with required 18 V)
buck_proposal.startup: EN5 float per TI internal pullup; no output-derived enable; internal 5ms typical soft-start. No PG output; MCU pad7 now unused.
buck_proposal.input_contract: J_PWR already protected upstream: 9-18 V normal, positive polarity, fuse/current limit, hot-plug/transients <=28 V at IC including ringing, no negative excursions. No onboard reverse diode/TVS claimed. Upstream protection design and validation remain open.
buck_proposal.inductor: Bourns SRP6060FA-150M, 15uH +/-20%, 43mOhm max DCR, Isat 5.8A typical at 30% drop, Irms 4.5A typical at 20C rise
buck_proposal.caps: C_IN 22uF X7R 50V effective >=10uF at 18V plus 100nF; C_OUT/C_OUT2 each 22uF X7R 25V effective >=15uF at 5V; BOOT-SW 100nF X7R 16V; C_FF 75pF C0G 50V. Effective limits include bias/tolerance/temp/aging; exact ceramic MPN curves remain procurement gate.
buck_proposal.feedback: 100k/13.5k both 0.1%, 5.011V nominal, 4.876-5.146V reference+tolerance envelope before ripple/transients
buck_proposal.release_limits: Analytical candidate only; startup/load-step/stability/thermal and RF noise not measured; no physical boot claim

plus5V_PCBA.from: PROPOSED TPS54202DDCR replacement, configured nominal 5.011 V
plus5V_PCBA.rated: 4.5-28 V in, 2 A silicon capability; board target >=0.5 A continuous / 1 A peak subject to thermal validation
plus5V_PCBA.constraint: the 18 V system upper bound EXCEEDS the TPS62162's 17 V rating and must be enforced by upstream protection, or the regulator variant changed -- recorded in the freeze

plus5V_LNA_SW.reason: an LNA fault must not collapse the MCU rail
plus5V_LNA_SW.limiter: resettable current limiter OR load switch
plus5V_LNA_SW.bypass: 100 nF + 10 uF at the tee DC injection point

plus5V_VGA.feed: ferrite bead or pi filter from +5V_PCBA

plus3V3_MCU.load: RP2040, digital + ADC + SPI, 50 mA design allowance

active_devices.func: MCU, SPI control, ADC input, watchdog, telemetry

active_devices.part: TI TPS54202DDCR (PROPOSED replacement of frozen TPS62162)

active_devices.func: bias tee for the masthead feed
active_devices.placement: at the masthead/feed boundary, NOT in series with the 433 receive path
active_devices.gate: confirm insertion loss / current rating from the delivered unit or current datasheet

dnp_by_design.reason: CLOSED BY D9/ADR-072: ISM uplink is attenuation-only; a higher-legal-footing PA is a FUTURE RESPIN, not an open v1 BOM row
CLOSED AS MECHANICAL OUT-OF-SCOPE; mechanical selection under ADR-076/077/078
the board does not add a 2.4 GHz PA
the board does not attempt to put the masthead LNA on the PCBA

rf_path.chain: 433 antenna -> 433 MHz BPF -> ZFBT-4R2GW+ RF/DC port -> ZX60-P103LN+ -> feed coax -> ZFBT-4R2GW+ RF/DC port -> ADL5240/VGA path

detector_tap.mandatory_2nd_bpf: a SECOND 433 MHz BPF before the AD8318 input
detector_tap.why: AD8318 is broadband; unfiltered 2.45 GHz leakage could falsely reduce RX gain

rf_path.grounding: detector ground and the ADC reference return to the quiet analog ground region

agc_control.bounds: bounded to the ADL5240's legal gain-control range
agc_control.deadband: at least one 0.5 dB step plus hysteresis
agc_control.watchdog: downlink-failure watchdog independent of the TX attenuation LUT; on loss or a watchdog service failure it returns the ADL5240 to a known fixed manual gain and reports the fault
agc_control.bypass: front-panel or commanded MANUAL/BYPASS selects the fixed gain without relying on the last AGC register state
agc_control.independent_of_rx_agc: TX range->attenuation remains operational even if RX AGC is bypassed or faulted

erc_requirement.invariant: no single LNA fault may remove MCU power
